statistic: number of CpGs passing limma raw two-sided p < 0.05 and abs(logFC) > 0.5
tail: upper: shuffled count >= observed count, including ties
interpretation: test for an excess of red sites, separately at each visit; no across-visit adjustment
permutation_unit: participant; one assignment shared by both visits and every CpG
variance_prior: re-estimated across all sites for each permutation
randomization: joint exchangeability within the supplied randomization blocks, conditional on the analyzed participants and observed diet counts in each block; requires the analyzed-subset selection to permit this exchangeability
limitations: Calibration requires joint exchangeability of whole participant profiles under the recorded allocation restrictions.
The analyzed subset and its observed diet counts are held fixed; selection and replacement mechanisms are not reconstructed.
A large p-value does not establish absence of a diet effect or identify individual false positives.
